title: Asymptotic stability of the degree-one vortex in the abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs model
summary: We prove asymptotic stability of the degree-one vortex in the $(1+2)$-dimensional abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs model at the self-dual coupling, for small equivariant perturbations in weighted Sobolev spaces. The abelian Yang-Mills-Higgs model is a classical relativistic field theory on $(1+2)$-dimensional Minkowski space, describing a complex-valued field coupled to an electromagnetic potential and admitting topological solitons known as vortices.
